notes.title: It's Check-In Time! Sunset Motel is Now Live on Steam 🛎️
notes.notes:
[h1]🌅 Today is the Day! 🌅[/h1]

After over a year and a half of passion, creativity, and countless cups of coffee, we’re so excited to finally welcome you to Sunset Motel — it’s now officially LIVE on Steam! 🛎️✨

[previewyoutube=iqEKsfWizHU;full][/previewyoutube]

What started as a small idea has grown into a full-fledged immersive experience thanks to your support and the dedication of our team. Whether you’re here to manage your dream motel, meet interesting guests, or party under the neon lights… this is an invitation for you to check in.

This release means the world to us, and we can’t wait to see how you explore, build, and bring Sunset Motel to life in your own style.

So grab your keys, pick your favorite room, and dive into the world of motel madness.

Thank you for being a part of our journey. This is just the beginning. 🧡

notes.title: Sunset Motel Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
[h1]🏨 Sunset Motel Officially Opens on April 18, 2025! 🌇[/h1]

Hello Sunset Motel Residents! Are your bags packed? Got your keys ready? Because Sunset Motel is officially opening its doors on April 18, 2025! ✨
After months of development, countless cups of coffee, bug fixes, and your amazing feedback, we’re finally in the home stretch.
Now it’s time to share this world with you. 🎉

[previewyoutube=OSFobOT5-jg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]What’s Waiting for You?[/h1]
A brand-new staff system: From bellboys to fitness coaches, your motel is more alive than ever!

New businesses: Car wash service, relaxing sauna, redesigned bar, and a customizable pool area just for your guests.

Bring nostalgia into your rooms with special quests from the antique dealer.

A packed experience with a full-featured gym and new service machines.

Enhanced decoration tools, more interactive elements, and surprise mini-games!

New languages, new details, and so much more!

💬 We’re truly grateful for your interest, feedback, and patience during the Prologue.
What makes Sunset Motel so special... is you.
This isn’t just a management game — it’s a story you helped create.
And in every corner of the motel, your presence can be felt.


[h1]🙏 With love, from Efkey Studios[/h1]
Thank you for believing in us, for waiting for our game, and for always keeping the motel light on.
Now pack your bags—because check-in time at Sunset Motel is just around the corner.
Your key is ready. 🛎️✨

[h2]Sunset Motel Development Team :)[/h2]
[h1]Due to an unexpected event, we are postponing the release date a little from April 16th to April 18th, but don't worry, we are coming full speed on April 18th :)[/h1]

notes.title: 🎉Sunset Motel Prologue is Now Out!🎉
notes.notes:
[h1] Dear motel managers, [/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2905970/Sunset_Motel_Prologue/

The moment you have been waiting for with great excitement has finally arrived! Sunset Motel Prologue is now live and offers you the opportunity to create your motel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/9c9a23a48705d2709957357125c6a4282de07212.png[/img]

[h3]Designed from Scratch: 3 Fully Customizable Rooms[/h3]

-Over 150 furniture options to personalize each room to your taste and style.

-New paint, new wallpaper, new flooring

[h3]A new employee[/h3]

-An employee to take care of some of your guests' needs

-Make your job a little easier

[h3]A Sneak Peek at a New Facility[/h3]

-A peek at a new facility: the pool!

-You can play a part in the pool, repairing, rebuilding, cleaning

[h3]Hosting a Variety of Guests[/h3]

-Rent out your rooms to a wide variety of clients, each with unique preferences and needs.

-New looking npc's

-New voice acting

[h3]New service mechanics[/h3]

-You will see a few new service mechanics as you play the game

[h3]New games of chance[/h3]

-Don't forget to check the bar for new games of chance :)

[h3]New Steam Achievements[/h3]

-Unique achievements that you will earn for every job you do

There is still a lot to do, but we can't wait to share the world we have created so far with you.

Don't forget to join our Discord community to hear your feedback and share your experiences:

[url=https://discord.gg/KXKNZMFJbr][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/c81823092d58f58b655c0c85626c5113d07e46bc.png[/img][/url]

If you like the game, we are waiting for your nice comments! Your comments will be a great support for us. Have fun creating your motel!

[h3] [EFKEY STUDIOS] [/h3]

notes.title: Sunset Motel Prologue Coming July 29th!
notes.notes:
[h1] Sunset Motel Simulation Enthusiasts,[/h1]

The moment we've all been waiting for is almost here! We're beyond excited to announce that the Sunset Motel Prologue will be available on July 29th.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2905970/Sunset_Motel_Prologue/


[h2] About the prologue [/h2]

[h3]Design from Scratch: 3 Fully Customizable Rooms[/h3]

-Over 150 furniture options to personalize each room to your taste and style.

[h3]New Mechanics to Serve Your Guests[/h3]

-Enhance your guests' experience with innovative and interactive service features.

[h3]Host a Variety of Guests[/h3]

-Rent out your rooms to a wide range of customers, each with unique preferences and needs.

[h3]A Few New Surprises[/h3]

-Discover unexpected elements that add a special touch to your motel.

-A Sneak Peek at a New Facility

[h2]Then let's dive into this adventure together[/h2]

How about creating your dream motel from top to bottom? Dive in and let your imagination run wild!
And of course, this is just a taste of what's to come in the full game. Look forward to even more fun features, interactions with NPCs like antique dealers, and the ability to make each room truly unique!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/deaca24806ea4548108b109df2d92e32729943ba.jpg[/img]

We can't wait to hear what you think! Join our community on Discord to share your experiences and connect with other players:

[url=https://discord.gg/KXKNZMFJbr][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/c81823092d58f58b655c0c85626c5113d07e46bc.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Sunset Motel Achievement Highlights[/h2]

As you progress through Sunset Motel, you'll unlock various achievements .You can unlock 15 achievements for the prologue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/b40b5b6a489d5d0ed3ecc69db4ea07a99bdbd593.png[/img]

You have given us very positive feedback so far. We are trying to make the game better day by day by looking at your feedback. Thank you for your support!



[h3] [EFKEY STUDIOS] [/h3]
